messages.content: Rewrite plain English in the manner of Hegel's writing, as his nineteenth-century English translators render it. Keep the content exactly: every claim, example and step, in the same order, and add nothing.

Rewrite in Hegel's manner:

Masterji’s command is the only ethical substance I have tasted today. The triangle of pastry is a concrete universal, binding my hunger to the moment. I must not let the abstraction of the file or the dream of India cloud this immediate satisfaction; the body is the first state.
